subject: Recap: sizing & pricing options for ACME pilot
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Claire Zhao <claire.zhao@acmeanalytics.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@acmeanalytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-12T16:10:00-07:00
Subject: Recap: sizing & pricing options for ACME pilot

Thanks again for the call earlier — quick recap and a few follow-ups so we can size the pilot and draft an offer: 

Summary of what I heard:
- Goal: add a real-time summarization + question-answer layer to ACME Insights (initial scope: 2 modules).
- Expected traffic: bursty during business hours; rough north-star estimate from you was in the low tens of millions of tokens/month depending on feature set.
- Success metrics: latency < 300ms p95, average qualitative improvement in user engagement, and cost per session under your target.

Clarifying asks from our side so we can put numbers on the pilot: 
1) Can you confirm an estimated monthly token run-rate for the pilot (best / expected / worst)? a ballpark range is OK.
2) What monthly budget range would you be comfortable with for a 45-day evaluation?
3) Target unit economics: do you have a target $/1M tokens you’re trying to hit (e.g., $XX / 1M tokens)?

Next steps I propose:
- You share the usage sketch (csv or small doc) — we can use that to model token burn and recommend a pricing/credits package.
- I’ll assemble a conditional credit + extension proposal and loop in Marissa for technical constraints and Lauren for approvals.

Also: If you’d like an extended trial window (we discussed 30–60 days), let us know the preferred length and any decision milestones you’re planning.

Attachments: I’ll attach a lightweight usage template for your convenience (ACME_usage_estimates.csv).

Thanks — I’ll wait for the usage sketch and your budget range and will follow up with a formal proposal.

—
Rafael Mendes
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0189
redwood.inference

From: Claire Zhao <claire.zhao@acmeanalytics.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@acmeanalytics.com>
Date: 2026-05-13T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap: sizing & pricing options for ACME pilot

Thanks Rafael — quick answers below. Sharing a rough usage sketch as discussed; will attach final numbers by EOD Friday.

Estimated token run-rate (pilot, depending on module set):
- Low: ~12M tokens/month
- Expected: ~22M tokens/month
- High: ~35M tokens/month (if both modules fully enabled)

Budget range for 45-day evaluation: our procurement has set aside roughly $5k–$8k for the initial pilot. If unit economics work out, we can scale quickly.

Target unit economics: ideally we’d see ~$40 / 1M tokens, but we can tolerate up to ~$60 / 1M for the evaluation period while we validate quality.

Trial extension: yes — we’d like to request a 45-day trial window (rather than standard 30) so we get enough data across week/month cycles. We can provide weekly check-ins and an evaluation artifact at day 30 and day 45.

Attachments: I will upload ACME_usage_sketch_v1.csv to the drive link you sent.

Appreciate you coordinating credits/pricing — cc’ing Tom who’ll coordinate procurement paperwork.

—
Claire Zhao
Head of Product — Data Experience
Acme Analytics
claire.zhao@acmeanalytics.com | +1 312-555-0246

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-14T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: ACME estimates + request for 45-day trial + credit ask (see below)

Marissa / Lauren — forwarding Claire’s note. Key points: expected ~22M tokens/mo for pilot, budget $5k–$8k for 45 days, target ~$40/1M (acceptable to $60). They explicitly requested a 45-day trial and asked whether we can top up trial credits (they asked informally for ~20k credits).

I’ve attached the usage sketch ACME provided (ACME_usage_estimates.csv). Can we: 
- Approve a 45-day pilot extension for ACME?
- Offer pilot credits (suggested number: 15k–25k, I’m flexible) — prefer to tie additional credits to milestone delivery (e.g., share day-30 metrics).

Notes for approval: they’re in procurement; small initial budget but high expansion potential if the unit economics hit their target. Sales / customer success engagement likely tied to a quick technical kickoff once credits are in place.

If it helps I can propose a conditional package: 20k credits up front + another 20k contingent on metrics/activation within 45 days. Thoughts?

—
Rafael

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-15T14:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: ACME estimates + request for 45-day trial + credit ask (see below)

Thanks Rafa — reviewed the sketch. Recommended path: we can provide a conditional pilot package to accelerate procurement and get them to a technical kickoff. Proposed offer: 

- 45-day trial extension (approved).
- 20,000 trial credits applied to their account immediately.
- Contingency: we’ll evaluate day-30 activation metrics (token burn, latency, qualitative signals). If metrics show meaningful activation, we’ll consider an additional 20k credit top-up and a 3-month discounted committed tier.

Pricing guidance for their run-rate: at 22M tokens/month, their $/1M target of $40 is below our standard enterprise list for comparable workloads; we can offer a promotional trial pricing equivalent via credits to get them the headroom they need to evaluate. If they convert to committed reserved capacity, we can price-match closer to their target depending on commitment level.

I’ve created the HubSpot task and attached the recommended mutual action plan for the kickoff. Rafael — please confirm with the customer that the conditional approach is acceptable, and I’ll queue the credits to be provisioned.

—
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Claire Zhao <claire.zhao@acmeanalytics.com>
Date: 2026-05-18T09:32:00-07:00
Subject: Credits applied + next steps for ACME pilot

Claire / Rafael / team — quick note to confirm operationally what we agreed: 

- We have applied 20,000 trial credits to Acme Analytics’ account. Credits are visible in the Console under Billing -> Credits and will be usable immediately.
- Trial window extended to 45 days starting today (2026-05-18).
- Milestone: day-30 activation check (Rafael and Marissa will sync to review token burn, p95 latency, and two qualitative success metrics). If activation metrics meet the bar, we will provision an additional 20k credits and discuss pricing for a 3-month reserved pilot.

Rafael — please schedule the kickoff tech call (I suggest May 20 or May 21) and add Marissa and Tom. Claire — welcome aboard, and thanks for providing the usage sketch; Marissa will use that to pre-size the pilot nodes and validate latency projections.

Attachments: mutual_action_plan.xlsx (I’ve uploaded a signed copy to the drive link).

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Head of Sales | Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123
